lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice placing inte in simple subordinate clauses.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues clarify plans when one person cannot join a fika.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining what is not possible and why.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about a fika plan, but one of them cannot come because the timing does not work.

main_focus.name: inte in subordinate clauses
main_focus.description: Put inte before the verb inside simple clauses with att, om, or när.
model_examples: Jag tror att jag inte hinner.
Om det inte går, tar vi fika senare.
När mötet inte är långt, hinner jag kaffe.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use subordinate clauses with inte naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic V2 word order in main clauses

vocabulary_target.theme: plans, timing, and not being able to join
useful_chunks: Jag tror att jag inte hinner.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use timing words and polite no-problem phrases to keep the situation friendly.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker suggests a short fika.
dialogue_shape.middle: A timing problem appears, and the dialogue uses inte inside subordinate clauses.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a later or simpler plan.

target_complexity.repetition: include a few clear examples of inte before the subordinate verb

focus: the timing problem that affects the plan
the reason the original fika does not work
the adjusted plan that solves the problem

sentence_focus: one sentence with att jag inte
one sentence with om det inte
one sentence about not having time
one sentence accepting the changed plan
